description: ADR 0228: reversing with full lock from 30 deg and keeping the throttle on after the trailer side wall meets the cab rear corner (the driver asks for ~120 deg): the body contact stops the fold near 117 deg, the drive axle pushes the trailer into the cab for ~3 s, then the driver brakes.

checks.source: per-step velocity change <= 0.35 m/s (kerb jerk ceiling, ADR 0165 / D58)
kingpin stays in the jaw through the contact (driving limit 5 mm)
the trailer reaches the cab and stays on it

articulation beyond the geometric contact angle (first contact of the level combination at 117.12 deg (trailer side wall, half width 1.275 m, on the cab rear corner x 1.245 m, 2.07 m ahead of the kingpin; CouplingContact.FirstContactArticulationDeg, analytic in JackknifeContactTests)); measured 1.4-1.7 deg = crush + plate pitch / roll lean
cab corner / trailer side crush while the drive axle pushes (5 Hz soft contact, measured 0.046-0.051 m) <= 7 cm
no rebound off the cab (crushing panels; recovery speed 0.05 m/s)
no spin-up: body angular rates stay at the folding rates (< 40 deg/s measured)
